prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle twin looped braids gathered behind each ear with short wispy bangs; costume silhouette large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor; design idea Nested overlapping panels curve upward like a sheltering rice bowl, their plain inner folds contrasting with the stately outer layers.; face an elegant, refined presence; expression gentle.
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Liu Yu of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the benevolent governor beloved of the people who could not wield the spear.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a clear adult face with soft, smooth contours.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; delicate V-line face with a small, soft chin; almond-shaped eyes of natural size; jade-green eyes; gently arched, slender brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Body and hair: curvy build; twin looped braids gathered behind each ear with short wispy bangs; silver-white hair.
Expression: a warm, gentle look with a faint smile, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: kindness and frugality, plain official robes.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: Nested overlapping panels curve upward like a sheltering rice bowl, their plain inner folds contrasting with the stately outer layers.
Colours: wisteria lavender, frost white, pale pine green and silver. Faction frame: wisteria-lavender and frost-white plating with pale pine-green trim and silver joints, gentle governor-citadel silhouette, pine and snowflake motifs, soft lavender glow lines.
Signature item: a bowl of rice, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: Both hands cradle the rice bowl at waist height, shoulders relaxed and feet naturally grounded.
Setting detail: A bright orbital relief-supply dock overlooking violet stars through a broad observation window.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
